title: The island
instructions: The X is always 8 cells right and 5 cells up from where you start, but the walls in between change every time. Get there on every map.
note: The last level. It's meant to be hard.
hint: Keep track of x, y, and which way the rover faces. Head toward the X while you can. When a wall blocks you, follow it like in the maze until you're closer to the X than where you got stuck and the way toward the X is open.
